title: Yellow Light: Stop if You Can Do So Safely

learnerPrompt: The light turns yellow. You have room to stop.
safeOutcome: You brake while there is room and stop just before the limit line.
unsafeOutcome: You continued into the intersection as the light turned red. Braking on yellow would have kept you clear.
